name: vscode-abl-mcp
description: VSCode ABL as a MCP server

vscode-abl-mcp.pipeEnabled.description: Enable the named pipe (Windows) / Unix domain socket (Linux/macOS) MCP transport. Recommended: each workspace gets its own pipe derived from its folder path, so multiple VS Code windows never conflict the way a shared TCP port can.

vscode-abl-mcp.autoCreateMcpConfig.description: When the MCP server starts, automatically create the workspace MCP client config (.mcp.json, .gemini/settings.json, .codex/config.toml) for any file or vscode-abl entry that doesn't exist. An existing entry written by this extension (it references mcp-pipe-proxy.js) is refreshed if its extension path or pipe path is out of date; any other existing entry is left untouched.

vscode-abl-mcp.httpEnabled.description: Enable the HTTP MCP transport on a fixed TCP port. Useful for clients that can't use a stdio-based server, but a shared port can conflict when multiple workspace windows are open.

vscode-abl-mcp.port.description: The port number for the MCP server (used only when the HTTP transport is enabled)

vscode-abl-mcp.host.description: Host address for the MCP server (used only when the HTTP transport is enabled)

vscode-abl-mcp.defaultEnabled.description: Whether the MCP server should be enabled by default on VS Code startup

file.description: Enable file operations tools (read, write, list files)

edit.description: Enable file editing tools (create, edit, delete files)

symbol.description: Enable code symbol and structure analysis tools

vscode-abl-mcp.enabledTools.description: Configure which MCP tools are enabled

commands.title: Install Config for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI

scripts.pretest: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
